name: Toyosu Market tuna auction

name: Asakusa Sumo Club
notes: 2-hr show with retired pro wrestlers + all-you-can-eat chanko + 1 drink, chance to get in the ring. Slots 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, 20:30. NOTE: no real sumo in Tokyo Nov 11-16 (tournament is in Fukuoka Nov 8-22, stables have no Tokyo practice until Dec). Shows are the move.

name: HIRAKUZA Ginza (sumo live restaurant)
best_time: Check the dated calendar. Evening showtimes vary by date.
notes: Premium sumo dinner show, opened Jan 2026, fully in English, kaiseki + concert lighting + audience Sumo Challenge. B1F 1-9-13 Ginza. Book on their site: https://ars-hirakuzat.triplabo.com/home?lang=en . Card only.

name: Shinjuku Sumo Club

name: Gold's Gym Harajuku Tokyo
notes: Flagship Gold's, 24 hrs, bath + sauna. Visitors need a member to accompany OR approval via their visitor procedure, plus passport. Tattoos must be covered. Closed 3rd Monday. Cheap no-hassle backup: Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium in Sendagaya (JPY 700 / 2.5 hrs).

name: Minami-Aoyama Shimizuyu (sento)

name: Tokyo Toyosu Manyo Club (onsen)
best_time: Evening after teamLab, or post-Toyosu morning
notes: 24-hr onsen complex with hot-spring water trucked from Hakone/Yugawara, rooftop foot bath with bay views. Baths close 3:00-5:00. Next to Senkyaku Banrai food hall.

name: Spa LaQua (Tokyo Dome)
notes: Natural hot-spring spa, open 11:00-09:00. Nov 11 is a pricier D day, Nov 13-16 cheapest A. Late-night surcharge JPY 2,500 if staying 1:00-6:00. 1 min from Korakuen Sta. Tattoo restrictions apply.

name: HUB Shibuya (British pub / sports)
best_time: Any sports night; happy hour till 19:00
notes: Chain British pub, screens for football/sports, cheap pints, easy. B1F Ichigo Fiesta Bldg, Udagawacho. Many HUB branches across Tokyo if you want a game on.

name: The Bellwood
notes: Gorgeous wood-paneled cocktail bar from the SG Group, Okushibuya. 18:00-02:00 daily.
